## Live Versions is now open source

Live Versions is now free software under the **GNU General Public License v3.0 or later**. You can use it, share it and change it. If you distribute a changed version, its source has to be available under the same license.

- The exe's file properties and `LiveVersions help` show the copyright and license.
- Each release now includes **THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt**, the licenses of the libraries and fonts built into the exe.
- `LiveVersions help` now lists the `duplicate` mode of the `vst3` command.

Nothing else changed since 0.3.3: saving versions, change notes and the VST3 converter work exactly the same.

Live Versions is not affiliated with or endorsed by Ableton.
